answer: Distinct-Action Quota Pricing. Each identity may perform only one new kind of action per epoch; repeating a known action is free, but each novel action requires a scarce coordination permit drawn from a shared violet pool. Permits are allocated by a garden-style lottery weighted by prior distinct actions, so fresh identities start empty. When many fresh identities coordinate, permits deplete and the marginal price of a permit rises steeply, like a river constricting at a narrow mouth.
